evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, two_slot_health still reads the current heartbeat via _tick_value before invoking the observe/first-tick polling callback. On a fresh host with no heartbeat.json, that read raises and the health command fails (exit 2) without using --first-tick-timeout-seconds. The timeout path in wait_for_first_tick only runs after this read, so the intended fresh-host wait is not honored. This is an implementation bug in existing health behavior, not a new requirement.
